title: SettingDefinition
description: The full Setting System input/output contract. Documents backend/jewelmind/setting/models.py — a Setting subsystem domain contract, NOT a second canonical JDL schema (JDL remains governed by specs/jdl/v1). Every field is kernel-neutral: no CadQuery or OCP object ever appears, so Forge, Studio, Designer and any future jewelry category can depend on this without importing a CAD kernel. See docs/bible/21-setting/setting-domain-model.md. Sub-schemas are INLINED under $defs (this codebase's specs convention avoids cross-file $ref); the standalone files remain the readable per-family reference. Sub-schemas are INLINED under $defs (this codebase's specs convention avoids cross-file $ref); the standalone per-family files remain the readable reference.

settingType.description: Only implemented families are enum members. CHANNEL/FLUSH/BAR/TENSION/BEAD/PAVE/CUSTOM are reserved names carried in setting-registry.json's reservedFamilies, with no generator (SETTING-GOV-005).

stoneSettingReference.description: The kernel-neutral facts a Setting may consume about one stone. A Setting reads these; it may never redefine stone geometry (SETTING-GOV-003).

girdlePlaneZMm.description: The reference plane a setting grips at.

isBilaterallySymmetric.description: False for pear. Lets a placement strategy refuse to assume symmetry it does not have (SETTING-GOV-008).

tipDirectionY.description: Signed local-Y direction a pointed asymmetric stone's tip faces; null when the shape has no distinguished tip.

settingAttachmentInterface.description: Mirrors backend/jewelmind/setting/models.py::SettingAttachmentInterface exactly. The generic, category-neutral handoff between a Setting and whatever structure incorporates it. A RingHead consumes this today; a future PendantBody or EarringBody consumes the same contract. Every value is supplied BY the category integration — the Setting never computes them from category fields (SETTING-GOV-001/014). See docs/bible/21-setting/setting-attachment-interface.md.

attachmentPlaneZMm.description: Z of the plane the setting attaches down onto. For a ring this is the top of the band, but the Setting does not know that.

embedMm.description: How far setting geometry sinks past the attachment plane so a boolean union yields real 3D overlap rather than a tangent touch. A kernel/boolean-robustness value, never a jewelry threshold.

supportHeightMm.description: Vertical distance from the attachment plane up to the stone's girdle plane.

prongSetting.description: Mirrors backend/jewelmind/setting/models.py::ProngSettingDefinition. The prong-family half of the discriminated Setting model. `prongCount`/`prongDiameterMm`/`prongHeightMm` map 1:1 from the public JDL fields via geometry/setting_adapter.py; `placementStrategy` and `style` are Setting-internal and resolved from the stone. See docs/bible/21-setting/prong-setting-contract.md.

prongCount.description: Real requested count. 4 and 6 are the counts the generator builds and JM-PRONG-001 permits; an out-of-set value surfaces as a structured validation result, not a parse error.

style.description: Only the cylindrical reference prong is implemented. CLAW, V_PRONG, SHARED_PRONG and CUSTOM_PRONG are reserved names with no geometry — deliberately NOT enum members (SETTING-GOV-005). V_PRONG in particular is what real pear/marquise tip protection would need.

bezelSetting.description: Mirrors backend/jewelmind/setting/models.py::BezelSettingDefinition. The bezel wall is derived by offsetting the stone's OWN girdle outline, so the pipeline is outline-agnostic and a future custom outline flows through unchanged (brief section 19). See docs/bible/21-setting/bezel-setting-contract.md.

wallThicknessMm.description: Constant geometric offset applied outward from the stone girdle outline. When defaulted (0.6) this is a PRELIMINARY SOFTWARE VALUE in the same class as band.width — a deliberate, configurable software choice, NEVER a professional recommendation (SETTING-GOV-010). No minimum is enforced because no sourced professional minimum exists.

wallHeightMm.description: Total vertical extent of the wall. When defaulted (2.5) this is likewise a PRELIMINARY SOFTWARE VALUE.

verticalReference.description: The wall is centred on the stone's girdle plane: bottom at girdlePlaneZ - wallHeight/2, top at girdlePlaneZ + wallHeight/2. An explicit, symmetric rule chosen precisely to avoid fabricating an asymmetric crown/pavilion coverage split.

outlineOffsetMode.description: A true constant-distance offset (cq.Wire.offset2D), not a scaled outline — so wall thickness is uniform around the whole perimeter.
